name: Nutritional Yeast
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and provides beneficial B-vitamins without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Store in airtight container in cool, dry place to maintain freshness
Add after cooking to preserve B-vitamin content
Start with smaller amounts if new to nutritional yeast flavor
Sprinkle on popcorn, pasta, or salads for umami boost
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of B-vitamins, especially B12
Complete protein with all essential amino acids
Naturally low in sodium and fat-free
